an3.98:1.1: 99 tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an3.98:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhaddo assājāniyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca
an3.98:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhaṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an3.98:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an3.98:1.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti balasampanno ca javasampanno ca.
an3.98:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti
an3.98:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.98:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an3.98:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati …pe… anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an3.98:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an3.98:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an3.98:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an3.98:4.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
